Our story

It began with one bed behind a kitchen

Twelve years ago we built a single raised bed behind a restaurant kitchen, to have herbs at hand. The neighbours asked for one each, and then their friends did.

Today we build a few hundred a year, and still plant the first seeds with every new gardener.

Why raised beds

Three reasons we keep coming back to.

  • Warmer soil

    The soil warms earlier in the spring.

  • Kinder to the back

    No kneeling to weed.

  • Fewer snails

    They seldom climb the sides.

Interview

Soil first

A grower on why the bed matters more than the seed

Thirty years of beds have taught her to feed the soil and let the plants feed themselves.

Published 10 October 2026 By A. Writer Growing

She has grown vegetables on the same plot since before most of her neighbours were born.

The bed comes first

What did you find?

That the soil decides almost everything.

And the seeds?

They follow.
